question:
A reverse-biased photodiode has quantum efficiency $\eta=0.50$. It is illuminated by monochromatic radiation coming from hydrogen atoms undergoing the $3\to2$ transition. Incident optical power is $P_0=1.0\,\text{mW}$, but $10\%$ is reflected so only $0.90P_0$ is absorbed.

The photocurrent passes through a load resistor $R_L=2.0\,\text{k}\Omega$.

Use $E_n=-\dfrac{13.6}{n^2}\,\text{eV}$, $e=1.6\times 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$, and $1\,\text{eV}=1.6\times 10^{-19}\,\text{J}$.

Estimate (i) photocurrent $I$ and (ii) load voltage $V_{out}$.
